user.title: Battery Consumption
user.description: Choose the tracker name and battery percentage source.

data_description.tracker_name: Short device name used in Battery Consumption entity IDs and displayed device names.
data_description.source: Select the entity that provides the battery percentage.
data_description.attribute: Optional attribute containing the battery percentage. Leave empty to use the entity state.

capacity_source.title: Battery capacity source
capacity_source.description: Choose whether battery specifications come from a known device profile or are entered manually.

data_description.configuration_mode: Device profile shows only the profile list. Manual configuration shows only capacity, unit, and voltage fields.

profile.title: Device profile
profile.description: Select a known device. Battery capacity, unit, and nominal voltage are filled automatically.

data_description.device_profile: Select the exact device or battery profile.
data_description.precision: Number of decimal places shown for calculated values.
data_description.minimum_change: Percentage-point movement required before charge or discharge is confirmed. Use 0 to record every change.
data_description.session_timeout: Minutes without a confirmed change before battery activity returns to idle.
data_description.create_activity_sensor: Create a regular sensor showing charging, discharging, or idle.
data_description.create_cycle_sensor: Create a diagnostic sensor showing equivalent full discharge cycles.
data_description.create_power_sensor: Create a power sensor from confirmed battery movement and elapsed time.

data_description.battery_capacity: Enter the full capacity printed on the battery, for example 5050 with mAh or 19.5 with Wh.
data_description.unit_of_measurement: Select mAh, Wh, kWh, or MWh.
data_description.battery_voltage: Required for power calculations when capacity is entered in mAh.
